description: This PHP class, named APIKey, manages API keys for users within the TestLink project. It provides methods to generate, assign, and retrieve API keys from a database, encapsulating database interactions for API key management.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: A class that handles API key management, including creation, retrieval, and association with users, for the TestLink open source testing project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the APIKey object, establishes a database connection, and sets the database table for users.

methods.name: addKeyForUser
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new API key for a specified user ID, updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-random  MD5 hash based on concatenated random numbers to serve as a new API key.

methods.name: getAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a specific user ID if it exists.

methods.name: getAPIKeys
methods.description: Fetches all API keys or the API key for a specific user ID and returns them as an associative array.
